title: Measure the idle macOS runner minutes that docs-only PRs spent over the past 14 days
why: Lane notes-fix-merge-ci, 14:38 CST: checks-macos-b starts an idle macOS runner on docs-only PRs. Decision ci-job-caps says that cost is unmeasured. Skipping the job with a job-level if would break the all-jobs-passed rollup, which fails a skipped job.
note: Measure first, then ask: count docs-only PR runs and their idle macOS minutes from the past 14 days of Actions history (coordinator 14:41 CST). Then file a page question with the numbers: let the rollup accept a skipped scoped job (a widening of a shared check, never the pick), or keep as is. Taken without a page question, because a measure can be undone and needs no owner word (parallelism-keep-going). Note checks-macos-b-idle-runner keeps `Fix: none` until then. Cost: GitHub API reads, once. Measured (coordinator, 15:47 CST Nov 7): 134 idle macOS minutes across all repos in 2 weeks, $0.56 in the private repos, so it is no real cost. #1571 deletes the note and is with runner 8. The step is done when #1571 merges. Doing 05:58 CST Nov 10: open PR #1571 on branch ci-macos-idle-measure (triage live build).
